recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-30700 unless a future WG decision reopens renaming these normative parameters or adding a replacement UI/mode parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-30700 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested renaming the ValueSet $expand parameters excludeNested and excludeNotForUI and improving their descriptions; the final accepted resolution retained the normative names and replaced the descriptions with clearer semantics.
initial_application: No prior commit explicitly tagged FHIR-30700 was found. Git history shows commit 1c4a35dbe293f96f5b95682b627ef541a838ea92 updated source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml with the accepted excludeNested and excludeNotForUI semantics under a different Jira subject, with later cleanup leaving the current links and prose semantically aligned.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes valueset=ValueSet, so source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml is in build scope. Vocab minutes and the related Zulip thread confirm the WG chose to improve the existing parameter descriptions rather than rename the parameters or add a new mode parameter. Related FHIR-30702 and FHIR-30703 were already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current operation definition already states that excludeNested=true requires a flat expansion, excludeNested=false allows but does not require nesting, and excludeNotForUI controls whether notSelectable, no-code, and abstract navigation concepts may be included, including the FHIR Specification generation notes.
